mapper.select: SELECT A1.EMPNO as "empNo" ,A1.EMP_KOR_FLNM as "empKorFlnm" ,A1.BLNG_BRCD as "blngBrcd" -- 소속부점 ,A1.BSORGCD as "bsorgcd" -- 모점코드 ,A1.EMP_JOBCLS_CD as "empJobclsCd" ,A1.HRA_PSTN_CD as "hraPstnCd" ,A1.HRA_PSTN_NM as "hraPstnNm" ,replace(A1.RETM_DT, ' ','') as "retmDt" -- 퇴직일자 ,NVL((SELECT DISTINCT 'Y' FROM V_CQHPN_JOBPA_L B2 WHERE B2.EMPNO = A1.EMPNO AND B2.AFRS_DVDT_LCCD = '0' AND B2.AFRS_DVDT_MCCD = '000' AND B2.AFRS_DVDT_SCCD = '000005' AND B2.AFRS_DVDT_BASE_DT = ( SELECT MAX(C3.AFRS_DVDT_BASE_DT) FROM V_CQHPN_JOBPA_L C3 WHERE C3.EMPNO = A1.EMPNO AND C3.BLNG_BRCD != '0' ) ),'N') as "autGrpCd" -- 권한그룹_감사통활책임자여부 ,A1.OJBB_EMP_DVCD as "ojbbEmpDvcd" -- 직원구분 ,DECODE(A1.WORK_STCD, '3', 'R','A') as "workStcd" -- 퇴직구분 ,BRDD as "brdd" FROM V_CQHPN_PINFO_M A1
mapper.update: MERGE INTO OCUOC_USERI_M T USING ( SELECT #{empNo} AS EMPNO , #{empKorFlnm} AS EMP_KOR_FLNM , #{blngBrcd} AS BLNG_BRCD , #{bsorgcd} AS BSORGCD , #{empJobclsCd} AS EMP_JOBCLS_CD , #{hraPstnCd} AS HRA_PSTN_CD , #{hraPstnNm} AS HRA_PSTN_NM , #{retmDt} AS RETM_DT , #{autGrpCd} AS AUT_GRP_CD , #{ojbbEmpDvcd} AS OJBB_EMP_DVCD , #{workStcd} AS WORK_STCD , #{brdd} AS BRDD FROM DUAL )S ON ( T.EMPNO = S.EMPNO ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.EMP_KOR_FLNM = S.EMP_KOR_FLNM , T.BLNG_BRCD = S.BLNG_BRCD , T.BSORGCD = S.BSORGCD , T.EMP_JOBCLS_CD = S.EMP_JOBCLS_CD , T.HRA_PSTN_CD = S.HRA_PSTN_CD , T.HRA_PSTN_NM = S.HRA_PSTN_NM , T.RETM_DT = S.RETM_DT , T.AUT_GRP_CD = S.AUT_GRP_CD , T.OJBB_EMP_DVCD = S.OJBB_EMP_DVCD , T.WORK_STCD = S.WORK_STCD , T.BRDD = S.BRDD , LAST_CHNG_DTTM = TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE NVL(T.EMP_KOR_FLNM,' ') != NVL(S.EMP_KOR_FLNM,' ') OR NVL(T.BLNG_BRCD,' ') != NVL(S.BLNG_BRCD,' ') OR NVL(T.BSORGCD,' ') != NVL(S.BSORGCD,' ') OR NVL(T.EMP_JOBCLS_CD,' ') != NVL(S.EMP_JOBCLS_CD,' ') OR NVL(T.HRA_PSTN_CD,' ') != NVL(S.HRA_PSTN_CD,' ') OR NVL(T.HRA_PSTN_NM,' ') != NVL(S.HRA_PSTN_NM,' ') OR NVL(T.AUT_GRP_CD,' ') != NVL(S.AUT_GRP_CD,' ') OR NVL(T.OJBB_EMP_DVCD,' ') != NVL(S.OJBB_EMP_DVCD,' ') OR NVL(T.WORK_STCD,' ') != NVL(S.WORK_STCD,' ') OR NVL(T.RETM_DT,' ') != NVL(S.RETM_DT,' ') OR NVL(T.BRDD,' ') != NVL(S.BRDD,' ') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( EMPNO , EMP_KOR_FLNM , BLNG_BRCD , BSORGCD , EMP_JOBCLS_CD , HRA_PSTN_CD , HRA_PSTN_NM , RETM_DT , AUT_GRP_CD , OJBB_EMP_DVCD , WORK_STCD , BRDD , FRST_REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( S.EMPNO , S.EMP_KOR_FLNM , S.BLNG_BRCD , S.BSORGCD , S.EMP_JOBCLS_CD , S.HRA_PSTN_CD , S.HRA_PSTN_NM , S.RETM_DT , S.AUT_GRP_CD , S.OJBB_EMP_DVCD , S.WORK_STCD , S.BRDD , TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
